item.tib: ma cig srid pa rgyal mo'i gsang bskang mdos gzhung gi rgyan mchod ye shes lha bskang
item.coloph: srid rgyal gsang bskang mdos gzhung gi rgyan mchod ye shes lha bskang (skong) 'di/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin du/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin pos/ yi ge ris su bkod pa la/ nyes 'gal ci mchis lha la bshags/ dge ba'i 'gro drug sems can kun/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu gyur cig sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya// 13 shog grangs (508)la gsang skong las chad pa'i sho lo ka lnga yod//
